build_block.build_command_family: c/Makefile qwen36 Windows CUDA_DLL=1 in source-only private staging; no installed overwrite

required_before_execution: Pin full source delta, compiler and flags
Hash private engine and actually loaded CUDA DLL/runtime
Re-run sampler/rank oracles with exact build configuration
Compare diagnostic-off original vs candidate-off control; verify selector on route
Finite logits/full sampled token equality in load/correctness gate
No kernel, activation regime, tensor representation or offload change

environment_rules: SNAP is the existing registered qwen35-9b-q6 directory, read-only
Clean inherited tuning variables; record exact allowlisted environment and placement
Do not force GQ_EXACT or copy Dory selectors; native precision/placement identical in both arms
DORY_CPU_SAMPLE_RADIX=0/1 is the only algorithm factor; startup-cached, fresh process each arm
COLI_LOGIT_DUMP, DUMP, profiler and speculative/lookup drafter paths absent
Fail if chain declined, VRAM insufficient or fallback/placement differs; do not reduce workload

workload_blocks.token_gate: Freeze ACCEPT token count in CPU/preflight; short < long and long + 32 <= 2048; do not silently truncate
workload_blocks.cache: prefix off; fixed complete native layer/DeltaNet state; no skipped layers

phase_A.purpose: baseline sampler fraction, capacity, correctness and cold setup, not speedup
requests: one fixed short greedy warmup (8 output tokens, excluded)
one same-history greedy control (32 max tokens)
one same-history full-sort sampled request (32 max tokens)
phase_A.instrumentation: QPC total sampled-call wall time/count, token sequence hash, prefill start/end and completed forward boundaries; no vectors or GPU trace
phase_A.fraction: sum sampler wall / measured full sampled-request wall; also sampler / decode PROF wall. Report timer overhead and possible overlap; never add CPU/GPU times.
phase_A.stopping: Stop numerical, state or load failures. If credible full-removal Amdahl upper bound is <3% total-request gain, close model speed line without phase B. If fraction is invalid/overhead material, HOLD rather than infer benefit.

phase_B.admission: Conditional within parent approval only if phase A informative and worthwhile
phase_B.warmup: Same fixed short greedy warmup, 8 output tokens per fresh process, excluded
requests_per_process: same-history top_p1 sampled request, 32 max tokens
phase_B.checkpoint: Atomically persist both arms and identities after every complete pair; preserve failed/incomplete runs, never count them as complete
phase_B.precision: No logits, tensor, RNG or state change beyond equivalent sorting
phase_B.decision: Require exact tokens/text/count/stop, matched contexts and positive useful effect per block with controls consistent with noise. No pooled history estimates. Clear loss/negligible benefit closes that workload; do not spend G3-G5 rescuing it.
phase_B.augmentation: No automatic extra pairs. Request one additional balanced pair only if noise/controls could change retention; no sweep

measurements: spawn-to-READY cold setup and first-request latency separately from warm ROI
prefill completed tokens/time; decode forward and emitted-token rates with denominators
client TTFT, inter-DATA intervals (not falsely per-token), end-to-end and aggregate emitted tokens/wall
per-request and per-token latency distributions; empirical p95 only, no population-tail claim from tiny n
Windows process-tree peak working set/private bytes and total GPU used/free sampled 50ms; record sampler observer overhead
peak sampled GPU memory is a lower bound, not exact instantaneous allocation high-water
raw counts, EOS/limit, token/text hash, errors, RNG call count/final probe after all measured requests
total experiment/setup/build/monitor wall time, all starts including failures

gate_limits.G0: recipient fraction remains unknown until phase A
gate_limits.G1: reuse bounded sampler oracles only after exact configuration/identity checks; full model gate pending
gate_limits.G2: phase B short/long screen only, conditional
gate_limits.G3: not admitted; alternate Qwen3 attention-only model if useful, held-out prompt/context first
gate_limits.G4_G5: not admitted; full API/tools/cancel/recovery/rollback and configured regression before integration

rollback: Terminate private processes, remove no installed files; retain original runtime/profile/model hashes. Parent alone integrates any shared patch.
feedback: Append observed fractions, pair results, failures and decision to existing TRANSFER_REGISTRY.json cascade section; preserve synthetic negatives
